content.comment_body: Can someone assist? [product_name] module 1 --> KNX --> [product_name] module 2 --> KNX ... --> HMI? How do I connect HMI in this configuration?

Hello [user_name], This resource may help you organize your network: [url] Regarding HMI functionality – from the newer generation [product_name] modules with updated features, you can utilize the [product_name] display unit.

Your question is a bit unclear. What are you aiming to achieve? The [product_name] module can serve as a powerful controller with KNX. You can view all digital and analog input and output status via KNX. You are able to use KNX HMI components from any vendor. However, you cannot directly transfer a 'message text' from a [product_name] module across KNX.
Information about [company_name] products designed for KNX systems: [url] Includes details on displays and touchpanels.
